systems_found: Vermont State Colleges System: Vermont State University and Community College of Vermont

sources.download_url: https://www.uvm.edu/d10-files/documents/2025-11/Final-FY26-Base-Pay.pdf (FY26, 1.7 MB); https://www.uvm.edu/d10-files/documents/2024-12/2024-2025-Base-Pay.pdf (FY25, 1.7 MB); https://uvmd10.drup2.uvm.edu/d10-files/documents/2024-07/Final_FY24_Base_Pay.pdf, Final_FY23_Base_Pay.pdf, Final_FY22_Base_Pay.pdf, sr09.pdf through sr20.pdf (FY2009-10 to FY2020-21)
sources.coverage_years: FY2009-10 to FY2025-26 (one PDF per year; snapshot as of Nov 1)
sources.size: about 1.7 MB per PDF, roughly 4,000-5,000 rows
sources.blocker: Data is only in PDF (text-based, alphabetical table), so each year needs PDF table extraction. There is no department column.
sources.notes: Published by the Office of Institutional Research and Assessment. Base pay only: bonuses and extra pay are excluded. The PDFs look text-based, not scanned.

sources.institution: State of Vermont executive, judicial and legislative employees (NOT colleges)
sources.institutions_covered: none of the higher-education institutions (UVM and VSCS run their own payroll)
sources.notes: Checked: no department contains COLLEGE or UNIV. Recorded here so it isn't searched again. Related Socrata datasets (2is8-zt8g, 69uf-6qeu) are also state-only.

sources.institution: Vermont State University, Community College of Vermont
sources.blocker: Third-party aggregator, one page per person, sourced from public-records requests. No official VSCS publication found.
sources.notes: No official VSCS, VTSU or CCV salary list was found online.

private_extra: None found. Middlebury, Norwich, Champlain and Saint Michael's publish only the IRS 990.
gaps: No official person-level pay for Vermont State University or Community College of Vermont (would need a public records request). UVM has base pay only, in PDF, with no department.
notes: Rated the UVM PDFs B, since they are clean text PDFs with long history. The state Socrata salary dataset was checked and has no higher-ed employees, so it is rated D for this purpose. OpenPayrolls VTSU pages are listed as C.
